+# Own-occurrence child of the native event frontier
+
+Status: **source-reviewed candidate, independent audits and admission pending**.
+This is a narrowed child of `ssl-api-controller-event-genus-warrant.md`, not
+approval of the entire 9,420-definition event population.
+
+The exact native defining genus `happening.n.01` is “an event that happens”.
+Its verified ancestry contains `event.n.01`, “something that happens at a given
+place and time”. HAPPEN names occurrence in the primary NSM chart. Thus an exact
+native noun identity that denotes a happening-kind has its **own occurrence
+content**, rather than merely an event participant, potential or circumstance.
+That content warrants HAPPEN=+1, not any other coordinate or a complete vector.
+The warrant is this source definition and the approved own-definition boundary;
+neither existing signed cells, forecast reach, runtime expected answers nor
+model repetition supplies the derivation.
+
+The existing native guard language restricts the child to noun POS, attested
+native lemma membership, and verified `happening.n.01` ancestry. Two independently
+visible native-identity challenges are withheld using the existing exact
+`wordnet_other_than_synset:` guards:
+
+* `passing.n.02`, “euphemistic expressions for death”: the surface genus describes
+  expressions while the ancestry describes their referent. All seven native
+  lemma records are outside this child until that boundary is settled.
+* `elves.n.01`, whose full definition starts “an acronym for emissions of light
+  and very low frequency perturbations due to electromagnetic pulse sources”
+  before describing electrical flashes. This source mixes abbreviation identity
+  and occurrence identity; its one native lemma record is likewise withheld.
+
+These are scope reservations, **not HAPPEN=0, negative examples or evidence that
+the native source is globally wrong**. Every original observation and open cell
+survives. Exclusion is by exact source synset, not an unrecorded spelling list or
+arbitrary regex. The full native child census is retained, including challenges.
+The occurrence of “expression” in `hiss.n.01` (a fricative sound, sometimes an
+expression of disapproval) or `sublimation.n.02` (modification of an impulse's
+expression) is not itself a metalinguistic defining genus and does not authorize
+an exclusion. Those original full definitions remain available for challenge.
+
+Freeze discovery at `wordnet:explosion:explosion.n.01`, the native chemical or
+nuclear energy release. Reserve independent audit senses and spellings from
+three other native branches: `wordnet:collision:collision.n.01` (contact),
+`wordnet:fall:fall.n.07` (movement), and `wordnet:outbreak:outbreak.n.01` (direct
+occurrence). None is a runtime benchmark case or an alias of discovery. Audit
+inputs must contain the complete native definitions, constraints and source
+context, not the expected sign. NULL withholds the exact definition; an opposing
+answer triggers source/scope review rather than an automatic exception. Fewer
+than the ordinary admission contract's required independent signed audits does
+not pass admission.
+
+Before use, the ordinary provenance-checked exporter, reviewed-pattern workflow,
+admission, exact joint staging, atomic revision migration and full replay must
+all pass on the actual candidate. The same existing guards must be consumed by
+census, staging, model requests, migration and replay. A successful child does
+not settle the parent event ontology. Other native branches stay pending. No
+semantic gain, population assignment or publication is claimed by this warrant.
*** End Patch
